project_name: Industrial Equipment Failure Detection using LSTM Autoencoder
threshold_method: mean(train healthy sequence MAE) + 3 × standard deviation
reconstruction_metric: mean absolute error across all time steps and sensor features
split_strategy: grouped by unit_id: 70% train / 15% validation / 15% test
training_strategy: healthy windows only; labels used only for validation/test evaluation
default_inference_backend: portable NumPy inference from Keras v3 weights
responsible_use: Educational portfolio demonstration only; not a production maintenance or safety system.
